research_sources.title: Binance Public Data
bounded_claims: Official daily and monthly Spot and USD-M Futures archives are public.
Aggregate trades expose exchange-native timestamps and buyer-maker identity.
Archive checksum companions exist and archived files may later be revised.

research_sources.title: Periodicity in Cryptocurrency Volatility and Liquidity
bounded_claims: Bitcoin and Ether show recurrent within-hour volatility and volume patterns.
The documented periodicity is consistent with algorithmic activity and funding times.
Activity periodicity alone does not establish positive after-cost returns.

research_sources.title: The Quarter-Hour Effect: Periodic Algorithmic Trading and Return Predictability in Cryptocurrency Futures
bounded_claims: Perpetual-market activity clusters at one-, five-, and fifteen-minute boundaries.
The paper reports that quarter-hour opening order imbalance forecasts four-to-twelve-hour returns.
The result is external preprint evidence and must be independently falsified by Aurex.

research_sources.title: Intraday return predictability in the cryptocurrency markets: Momentum, reversal, or both
bounded_claims: Intraday crypto predictability can exhibit both momentum and reversal.
Liquidity, jumps, macro events, and regimes can change the sign or strength.
Aurex must freeze one direction and reject regime-dependent rescue after outcomes.

mechanism.name: Periodic perpetual order-flow continuation into BTC spot
mechanism.causal_actor: Scheduled and algorithmic participants concentrating aggressive USD-M perpetual orders at recurring UTC quarter-hour boundaries.
mechanism.economic_premise: A concentrated burst of aggressive perpetual buying can reveal information or urgent demand before that pressure is fully incorporated into BTC spot over a slower multi-hour horizon.
mechanism.ex_ante_direction: Only positive, causally completed perpetual order-flow imbalance may later qualify a BTCUSDT spot-long decision; negative imbalance means cash, never a short.
mechanism.who_pays: Immediacy-demanding and mechanically scheduled traders pay market impact; slower cross-market assimilation is the proposed source of compensation.
mechanism.persistence_case: UTC scheduling and institutional execution constraints can recur, while a multi-hour expression is slower than latency arbitrage. Competition, venue maturation, and regime changes may erase the effect completely.
decay_and_failure_risks: the external result may not replicate on BTCUSDT spot after fees
the effect may be contemporaneous impact rather than forward information
quarter-hour participation and direction may change across regimes
a one-minute archive may be too coarse to isolate the causal opening burst
full taker fees and adverse slippage may dominate gross movement
signal overlap with momentum may make the mechanism non-independent
falsifiable_predictions: positive opening-window imbalance has positive net spot expectancy in development
the moving-block bootstrap expectancy lower bound is above zero
the result survives 1.5x and 2.0x trade-level cost stress
walk-forward and regime gates pass without selecting a sign or horizon afterward
validation passes before the one-shot future holdout is opened
profit is not concentrated in one day, month, or market regime
mechanism.observation_boundary: A later protocol must choose one UTC quarter-hour observation duration, one imbalance normalization, one positive threshold, and one holding horizon before reading development outcomes. The decision occurs only after every trade in the observation window is available.
mechanism.execution_expression: Future research may model a taker BTCUSDT Spot buy after the causal signal window and a taker Spot exit at one frozen horizon. No perpetual order, short, borrow, leverage, maker fill, or Testnet performance claim is permitted.

partitions.purpose: Feature arithmetic and one parameter set may be falsified here only after metadata, payload, quality, and execution protocols pass.
Untouched Q1 validation opened only after every development gate passes.
Exclude the pre-charter 2026 interval because current-market observation and prior Aurex work make it unsuitable as a clean Q1 holdout.
One-shot future holdout. It remains sealed until development and validation independently pass the universal factory contract.
Potential forward paper evidence only after a passing one-shot holdout and a separate promotion decision.

limitations: External research motivates a falsifiable mechanism; it is not Aurex edge evidence.
The V3P02 transport stop and prior proposal remain immutable and count in multiplicity.
The charter authorizes metadata and checksum census design only, not a network attempt.
No archive payload, price, signal, return, parameter, candidate, or strategy was created.
Pine cannot reproduce exchange-native perpetual aggressor flow exactly.
Testnet fills and zero commissions cannot establish real-market expectancy.
Production account, legal, tax, live, and real-capital facts remain unresolved.
